api.advance: (run,{autoChoose:boolean=false}) -> new Run; pending blocks year unless autoChoose
api.decide: (run,optionId:string) -> new Run; resolves pending at same year
api.fork: (run,year:number,{seed:string}) -> new Run at year with timeline/decisions preserved through year, future random stream changed
api.previewWeights: (run,year=run.year+1) -> candidate pool with eligibility, primary/related/ordinary role, astroThemes, matchedThemes, themeFactor, factors and normalized selection weight

annualRecord.title: string
annualRecord.yearContext: year-specific qualitative reading, exact palace frames, mutations and same-star overlaps

decision.title: string
decision.astroThemes: theme IDs linked to actual triggering events

limits.probabilityNature: editorial conditional event-selection weights, not measured personal probabilities
limits.historical: No random edits to factual events or birth inputs; gaps remain gaps
limits.sourcePrivacy: Only sanitized S01–S31 refs. Raw source text/docs never copied.
limits.previousEdition: previous-edition.html keeps version1 engine, catalog and browser storage separate
